requirements.quote: `spectracut studio new --idea "launch film for AlterLab" --source <repo README or URL> --headless` creates a production with a schema-valid CreativeBrief and no other input
Every brief aspect not answered by the idea or sources gets a default with a one-line rationale, written to an `assumptions.md` artifact in the production
Non-headless mode asks at most 4 doubts per batch, each multiple-choice with a recommended option; headless takes every recommended option
Every proof point cites a fetched source id; unsourced claims are dropped and listed in assumptions, never invented
Brand forbidden words are enforced on the generated brief
No regression in the existing studio graph, producer and acceptance tests (`uv run pytest -q`)

deliverables.change: New module: per-film-type question bank, default+rationale per aspect, doubt batching (max 4, multiple-choice with recommended option), headless resolution, injectable source loader (path or URL), proof points only from fetched source text citing source ids, forbidden-word filtering (reuse writer/copy_gate matcher), assumptions.md rendering.
Add optional Assumption model and CreativeBrief.assumptions / dropped_claims fields (default empty; backwards compatible).
Regenerate snapshot for the additive CreativeBrief fields.
Add helper producing intake answers and pages from idea and loaded sources so discovery_nodes needs no hand-supplied input; keep departments network-free.
studio new: BRIEF optional; add --idea, repeatable --source, --headless; exactly one of BRIEF or --idea; after store.create write assumptions.md into the production dir.
New tests: defaults with rationale, max 4 doubts per batch, headless picks recommended, unsourced claims dropped, forbidden words enforced, brief schema-valid; offline fetcher.
Add CLI test for studio new --idea --source --headless producing assumptions.md; existing tests unchanged.

preserve.what: `studio new BRIEF` behaviour and output lines asserted in tests/cli/test_cli.py:84 (hand-written brief path, exit code 2 errors)
Departments never touch the network (src/spectracut/studio/departments/discovery.py docstring; docs/engineering/contracts/departments.md)
Existing Brief/CreativeBrief JSON without assumptions still validates; tests/spec/test_schemas.py VALID fixtures and tests/spec/test_schema_compat.py

validate.command: uv run pytest -q tests/studio/test_intake.py tests/studio/test_discovery.py tests/studio/test_graph.py tests/studio/test_producer.py
uv run pytest -q tests/cli/test_cli.py tests/spec/test_schemas.py tests/spec/test_schema_compat.py

decisions.choice: Source fetching lives in studio/intake.py (CLI side) with an injectable fetcher, not in a department
New CreativeBrief fields are optional with empty defaults and the snapshot is regenerated
decisions.justification: additive-only schema compat checked by tests/spec/test_schema_compat.py

decisions.choice: Reuse the copy_gate whole-word case-insensitive matcher for forbidden words
